title: A governed history is read only with the registries it declares, by every reader
note: Stage 1, AUD-020. GH1 to GH6 remove a rule of the log's gate and its declaration: the GOVERNED refusal, either registry's comparison, the strength of a pinned profile, the declaration's shape, and the signed declaration. GH7 and GH8 remove the binding of every role-enforcing reader to its log's registry. GH9 makes the declaration name the wrong registry. GH10 to GH13 remove the independent reader's restatement. tests/test_governed_history.py holds each with a real authenticated history and a principal who is authenticated and not authorized.

mutations.rationale: a GOVERNED history is read by a log holding neither of the registries it declares
